problem:
Consider the straight line given by the following parametric equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=5-4t \\ y=-7+3t \\ z=9-t\end{aligned}
$$

Find a vector that is parallel to the line.
worked_solution:
First, let's find the corresponding vector equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5-4t \\ -7+3t \\ 9-t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -7 \\ 9\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-4t \\ 3t \\ -t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -7 \\ 9\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\ r & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -7 \\ 9\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$ 

This implies that the line passes through the point $(5,-7,9)$ and is parallel to the vector $v=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$
